criticisms.randomness: FAIR: one month is mostly noise; we admit it but do not yet measure it.
criticisms.safeguards: PARTLY FAIR: true that production AI is not an LLM stock-picker, but that is the experiment's question; loose Season 1 limits are fair, Season 2 fixes them.
criticisms.confirmation_bias: FAIR: the sharpest point; peer grades help but do not test whether the AI follows its own stated exit logic.

most_important: L1: it turns the biggest criticism into a number.
